title: Najafi Cosmetics — Multi-Platform E-commerce Network
summary: Designed and developed three Shopify e-commerce platforms for Najafi Cosmetics, covering GCC retail, wholesale B2B, and professional beauty customers, with each storefront tailored to its specific audience and business requirements.
description: Najafi Cosmetics required separate digital experiences for its different customer segments rather than operating retail, wholesale and professional customers through a single generic storefront. I designed and developed three dedicated Shopify e-commerce platforms: Najafi.ae for GCC retail customers, Najafi Wholesale for business and bulk buyers, and Najafi Professional for salons and beauty professionals.

Najafi.ae was developed as the main consumer-facing beauty and cosmetics store, while Najafi Wholesale was structured around the requirements of retailers, salons and business partners looking for wholesale products, pricing and bulk ordering. Najafi Professional was created as a dedicated ordering platform for beauty professionals, salons, authorised resellers and professional customers.

Across all three platforms, I translated business requirements into functional Shopify storefronts while focusing on product presentation, customer journeys, navigation and e-commerce operations. The result was a connected multi-platform e-commerce ecosystem with dedicated experiences for retail, wholesale and professional customers.
highlights: Three dedicated Shopify storefronts for retail, wholesale and professional customers
B2C and B2B e-commerce experiences designed around different customer requirements
End-to-end storefront development, implementation and e-commerce functionality

title: Najafi Beauty Wallet — Loyalty Programme
summary: Designed and launched a loyalty programme from scratch to convert one-time beauty shoppers into repeat customers, growing the subscriber base and lifting repeat purchase rate.
description: Najafi's biggest acquisition problem wasn't getting a first purchase — it was getting a second one. There was no structured reason for a customer to come back.

I introduced the Najafi Beauty Wallet, a loyalty programme layered onto the existing retail store, giving customers a reason to register, return and spend again. The programme significantly increased the subscriber base and repeat sales after launch.
This sat alongside the wider retention stack — email marketing and seasonal discount campaigns — that I plan and execute across the brand.
highlights: Conceived, built and launched without an existing loyalty framework to build on
Directly tied to email marketing and seasonal campaign calendars
Measurable increase in repeat purchase behaviour post-launch

title: Oserth — Amazon Brand Storefront & Marketplace Presence
summary: Registered and built out Oserth's branded presence on Amazon, alongside Amazon Sponsored Ads management and FBA integration that grew sales across the wider catalogue.
description: Beyond the owned storefronts, a meaningful share of demand for Najafi's brands sits on marketplaces — Amazon and Noon chief among them.

I registered multiple brands on Amazon and built out a dedicated Oserth brand page on Amazon.ae, then ran Amazon Sponsored Ads and Amazon FBA integration across the catalogue — work that contributed to a 30% increase in sales.

Day to day, this means managing two Amazon seller accounts and two Noon seller accounts alongside the owned Shopify/WordPress stores, keeping pricing, listings and stock consistent everywhere the brand sells.
highlights: Branded Amazon storefront built for Oserth
Amazon FBA integration and Sponsored Ads management
Four marketplace seller accounts run in parallel with owned stores

title: Spec Brite Group — Marketplace & Ads Operations
summary: Built and optimised Shopify/WordPress stores while running Meta, Google and Amazon Ads across multiple marketplace listings, with a consistent focus on ROAS.
description: At Spec Brite Group I owned the full stack behind the company's online sales — the storefronts themselves, the marketplace listings, the ad campaigns driving traffic to them, and the CRM and IT systems underneath.

That meant building and optimising Shopify and WordPress stores, keeping product listings and pricing accurate across Shopify, Amazon, Noon and local marketplaces, and running Meta Ads, Google Ads and Amazon Ads with ROAS and conversions as the north star.
It also meant the less visible work: administering Zoho CRM workflows and automations, managing hosting/DNS/SSL, and running the company's Microsoft 365 environment and general IT support.
highlights: End-to-end ownership: storefronts, marketplaces, ads, CRM, IT
Meta Ads, Google Ads and Amazon Ads managed concurrently
Zoho CRM workflow design and automation

title: Wellness Terminal — Multi-Country E-commerce Expansion
summary: Developed and managed multi-country e-commerce websites for Wellness Terminal across the UAE, Lebanon and Oman, using regional subdomains, Shopify and AWS DNS configuration to support localized market expansion.
description: Wellness Terminal wanted to expand its online presence beyond its primary UAE market while maintaining a consistent brand and e-commerce experience across multiple countries.

I developed and managed regional e-commerce websites under subdomains for the UAE, Lebanon and Oman markets, leveraging Shopify to provide a seamless and scalable e-commerce infrastructure across the different regions.

I also configured DNS records through AWS to ensure reliable access to the regional storefronts. The project enabled Wellness Terminal to establish a stronger international presence while maintaining a consistent digital experience across all three markets.
highlights: Multi-country e-commerce presence across UAE, Lebanon and Oman
Shopify-based regional storefront development and management
AWS DNS configuration for reliable regional access

title: Oserth Haircare — Global D2C E-commerce Platform Development & Expansion
summary: Developed and managed Oserth Haircare's global Shopify e-commerce ecosystem across GCC, Europe, Sweden and Western markets, building localized storefronts and implementing the technology, payments, analytics and retention infrastructure behind international growth.
description: Oserth Haircare required a scalable global e-commerce infrastructure capable of serving customers across different regions while maintaining a consistent brand experience. I developed and managed localized Shopify storefronts covering the GCC, Sweden, wider Europe and Western markets.

The project involved implementing and managing regional payment solutions including Shopify Payments, Stripe, Tabby and other third-party services, alongside multi-currency and VAT configuration. I also configured analytics tracking, automation workflows and supporting e-commerce integrations across the different storefronts.

Beyond the technical infrastructure, I continuously optimized the customer journey and conversion experience while implementing retention tools including loyalty programmes and other growth-focused improvements. This created a connected D2C ecosystem capable of supporting Oserth's expansion across multiple international markets.
highlights: Four localized Shopify storefronts across GCC, Sweden, Europe and Western markets
Regional payments, multi-currency, VAT, analytics and automation infrastructure
Conversion optimization and loyalty initiatives supporting international D2C growth
